content:
rita: Heads-up / HelixSwap kickoff in 45m. They want a 48h tech POC to validate migration from their current LLM vendor. Musts: identical request/response shape, preserved webhook retries, and token accounting that won't surprise procurement.

omar: Noted. Their vendor sends callbacks to /v1/callback with headers X-Req-Id and X-Retry-After. We can build a facade to echo exact fields. Biggest mismatch: they expect meta.tokens_total int. I can alias our meta.tokens->meta.tokens_total.

dana: Product caveat  our default streaming tokens come in chunks; HelixSwap's consumer expects a single final JSON. Proxy should buffer and POST final payload. Also recommend pinning to model v2.1-compat for the POC to limit style drift.

yousef: For parity testing: run 2k seed prompts through both endpoints, log token counts under both tokenizers, compute embedding cosine and ROUGE, and flag >10% semantic variance. I can spin up a deterministic run on Dedicated if we reserve a tiny pool. ETA 20h to prep.

clare: Security note: they require mTLS for callbacks, IP allowlist, Azure AD SAML SSO, and a completed security questionnaire. They also want assurance that POC data won't be used for training and that logs are KMS-wrapped. I requested their SP metadata.

legal: HelixSwap wants a POC addendum: 30-day retention, no secondary use, and POC-limited liability. We can do this; need to confirm purge automation and signer.

rita: Action items: @omar response alias + callback facade; @yousef run parity job; @clare send SOC2 excerpt and KMS notes; @legal draft POC addendum. Helix contact: integrations@helixswap.com.

omar: Quick curl smoke I'll use (replace API_KEY):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.dev/helix/generate \
  -H "X-Req-Id: hs-poc-001" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the transaction...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0}'
```

Proxy will buffer streaming and POST final JSON to their callback with meta.tokens_total included.

yousef: Token billing Q they asked: will billing be 1:1 with their current vendor? Short answer: unlikely. Tokenizers differ. For the POC propose fixed trial credit (e.g., 75k tokens) and run an invoiceable smoke to compute a multiplier for reconciliation.

clare: I uploaded SOC2_excerpt_redwood.pdf to the drive and sent it to helixsec. Netops asked for our egress CIDRs: 34.201.12.0/24, 18.132.77.0/24. Sending to them now.

legal: I'll draft the 30-day addendum and include the purge flow. Who owns purge implementation?

yousef: I'll add a POC tag and an automated purge job triggered 30 days after tag creation. Will include a runbook with TTL toggle for Hosted vs Dedicated.

omar: Two demo talking points: (1) exact JSON shape preservation (show before/after), (2) token multiplier visualization and reconciliation plan. Offer deterministic mode (temperature=0) for stricter parity.

sec-bot: deploy check: compliance docs present=true, SOC2=true, kms_integration=true

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=helix/compat-proxy build=901 ETA=6m :rocket:

rita: Current blockers: (1) Helix's sec team paused on SAML metadata, (2) procurement wants example invoice showing token multiplier scenarios. @clare can you push SAML ask and @yousef make a sample invoice?

clare: Sent SAML metadata request and asked for their SCIM/SSO contact. Also sent KMS ARN template.

yousef: I'll produce a sample invoice that shows native-token billing vs Helix-token billing using the paired-run multiplier and include both numbers side-by-side. ETA 24h after first run.

rita: If legal or security blocks >24h, escalate to AE. Aim: POC live and parity report within 48h. Keep updates compact here. :thumbsup:
